constraints: Only compresses BLOBs whose size is >= 255 bytes; smaller BLOBs are silently left uncompressed (no error) and the OK variable is set to 0.

After the call, the OK system variable is set to 1 on success, 0 if compression could not be performed (including the too-small-BLOB case). Error -10600 is only generated if the BLOB itself is damaged.
A compressed BLOB is still an ordinary BLOB and can still be modified directly; doing so may prevent EXPAND BLOB from decompressing it correctly.

overloadMerges.note: blob is compressed in place (inout, not read-only 'in'); added sentinelValues for the documented compression constants and the 'any other value/omitted' default.

params.name: compression
params.default: 1 (Compact compression mode) if omitted or an unrecognized value is passed

sentinelValues.meaning: Compact compression mode: most compact, slowest to compress/decompress (default)
Fast compression mode: fastest to compress/decompress, larger result
GZIP best compression mode: most compact GZIP compression
GZIP fast compression mode: fastest GZIP compression

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Compresses the contents of a BLOB in place using the selected (or default) compression algorithm, when the BLOB is large enough to be worth compressing.
